يعتطف (form VIII)

# يُعْتَطَفُ (yuʕtaṭafu) /juʕ.ta.tˤa.fu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
# يَعْتَطِفَ (yaʕtaṭifa) /jaʕ.ta.tˤi.fa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَطَفَ (iʕtaṭafa)
#
